plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 1729 (Jean-Jacques d'Ortous de Mairan proves a Mimosa plant in a pitch-black Paris cupboard still opens and closes its leaves on a daily cycle) · Jun–Sep 1962 (Jürgen Aschoff's Andechs bunker & Michel Siffre's alpine cave prove humans have an endogenous ~24.2-hour circadian rhythm, refined to 24 h 11 min by Czeisler 1999) · Sep 1971 (Ronald Konopka & Seymour Benzer at Caltech discover the first single-gene clock mutants — 19 h, 28 h, and arrhythmic — in the Drosophila Period gene) · 1984–1994 & 2002 (Jeffrey Hall, Michael Rosbash & Michael Young clone Period and Timeless and solve the PER/TIM negative-feedback hourglass, winning the 2017 Nobel Prize; David Berson & Samer Hattar identify 480-nm blue-light melanopsin retinal cells in 2002).
